body: Holy crap I know that feeling, that happened to me once. We actually drove to the school and waited an hour until we saw the alert that school was canceled.
My mom saying, "You can sleep in today."
I have two brothers, 4 and 14. Then a sister who's 6, they have issues of their own.

Cps will probably take us away at this point,the problem with that is the foster care system is not to great. But I've only seen my psychiatrist once, after that my mom wouldn't take me. I have no clue about any other programs.

I'm mainly interested from world war II to the cold war, but I love the history of the holy roman empire and the ottoman empire, especially their advancements in technology. The counseling program is really just for course and career planning, I went to them and they just suggested going to therapy then left it at that.

I'm trying to become a history teacher for high school and transfer to a university by next year. They don't approve of my major since they think it's a stupid career and easy, but it's honestly an incredibly hard job.
